author: Agent39
normalization_policy: Preserve every source card row and count.
Normalize only MEE-coded Basic Energy placeholders to an Expanded-legal SVE Basic Energy of the same type.
Normalize Battle Compressor PHF 92 shorthand to canonical card-pool identity xy4-92, retaining the PHF 92 printing.
Do not change any Pokémon, Trainer effect, Special Energy, or other card identity.
Keep the original source list alongside the derived normalized list.

banned_list_status.international: Agent3 official 49-printing overlay: zero exact banned-printing hits across all 29 source lists; eight stale bundled flags do not occur in this slice.
banned_list_status.japanese: Only same-name candidates are Unown AOR 30 (Farewell Letter, not DAMAGE/HAND) and Marshadow UNB 81 (Resetting Hole, not Let Loose).

physical_print_status: The normalized English lists are not proof of which exact Japanese cards were registered or played. Keep physical-source-print status unresolved.
